units.source_text: 《东京日日新闻》围棋记者五井同我对局，小野田六段给我们记录了棋谱。

en.t: Goi, the go reporter for the Tokyo Nichinichi Shimbun, played a game with me, and Onoda sixth dan recorded the game record for us.

units.source_text: 由六段担任记录不同寻常，这在名人对局中也没有过。

en.t: It was unusual for a sixth dan to serve as recorder; even in games by the Meijin, there had been no such precedent.
I played black and won by five points.

units.source_text: 这盘棋还在日本棋院的机关杂志《棋道》上刊登了。

en.t: This game was also published in Kido, the official magazine of the Nihon Ki-in.
